\subsubsection{The declared categories}

\paragraph{\texttt{bounded-linear, on normed-vector-space}}
\emph{Declared in} \texttt{theorem-library/categories.scm}.

Objects: the models of \texttt{is-normed-vector-space}.  Arrows: \texttt{is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f)} --- f is a bounded linear map from a to b.  Hom-set: \texttt{hom-bounded-linear(a, b)} --- the bounded linear maps from a to b.

Definition (\texttt{is-bounded-linear-arrow-def}, definitional):
\begin{VNBsnip}
forall([a, b, f], is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forsome([blk_ in rr], 0 <= blk_ and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(b))(f(x1_)) <= blk_ * (vnrm(a))(x1_))))
\end{VNBsnip}

Laws: \texttt{hom-bounded-linear-id} --- proven; \texttt{hom-bounded-linear-compose} --- proven; \texttt{hom-bounded-linear-in-set} --- proven; membership \texttt{hom-bounded-linear-member-iff} --- proven; Hom functors \texttt{hom-bounded-linear-post-type} --- proven, \texttt{hom-bounded-linear-pre-type} --- proven.

\paragraph{\texttt{c-continuous, on c-metric-space}}
\emph{Declared in} \texttt{theorem-library/c-continuous-category.scm}.

Objects: the models of \texttt{is-c-metric-space}.  Arrows: \texttt{is-c-continuous-arrow(a, b, f)} --- f is a continuous map of countably-metrised spaces from a to b.  Hom-set: \texttt{hom-c-continuous(a, b)} --- the continuous maps of countably-metrised spaces from a to b.

Definition (\texttt{is-c-continuous-arrow-def}, definitional):
\begin{VNBsnip}
forall([a, b, f], is-c-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-continuous(c-metric(a), c-metric(b), f))
\end{VNBsnip}

Laws: \texttt{hom-c-continuous-id} --- proven; \texttt{hom-c-continuous-compose} --- proven; \texttt{hom-c-continuous-in-set} --- proven; membership \texttt{hom-c-continuous-member-iff} --- proven; Hom functors \texttt{hom-c-continuous-post-type} --- proven, \texttt{hom-c-continuous-pre-type} --- proven.

\paragraph{\texttt{lipschitz, on metric-space}}
\emph{Declared in} \texttt{theorem-library/categories.scm}.

Objects: the models of \texttt{is-metric-space}.  Arrows: \texttt{is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f)} --- f is a Lipschitz map from a to b.  Hom-set: \texttt{hom-lipschitz(a, b)} --- the Lipschitz maps from a to b.

Definition (\texttt{is-lipschitz-arrow-def}, definitional):
\begin{VNBsnip}
forall([a, b, f], is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forsome([lpk_ in rr], 0 <= lpk_ and forall([lpx_ in pts(a), lpy_ in pts(a)], (dist(b))(f(lpx_), f(lpy_)) <= lpk_ * (dist(a))(lpx_, lpy_))))
\end{VNBsnip}

Laws: \texttt{hom-lipschitz-id} --- proven; \texttt{hom-lipschitz-compose} --- proven; \texttt{hom-lipschitz-in-set} --- proven; membership \texttt{hom-lipschitz-member-iff} --- proven; Hom functors \texttt{hom-lipschitz-post-type} --- proven, \texttt{hom-lipschitz-pre-type} --- proven.

\subsubsection{Inclusions}
Theorems of the form $P(a, b, f) \Rightarrow Q(a, b, f)$ for two arrow predicates, or $H_1(a, b) \subseteq H_2(a, b)$ for two hom-sets, found by shape.

\begin{itemize}
\item \texttt{hom-lipschitz-subset-hom-uniformly-continuous} (proven): \texttt{hom-lipschitz(a, b) subset hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b)}
\item \texttt{hom-metric-space-is-lipschitz-arrow} (proven): \texttt{is-hom-metric-space(a, b, f) implies is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f)}
\item \texttt{hom-metric-space-subset-hom-lipschitz} (proven): \texttt{hom-metric-space(a, b) subset hom-lipschitz(a, b)}
\item \texttt{hom-normed-vector-space-is-bounded-linear-arrow} (proven): \texttt{is-hom-normed-vector-space(a, b, f) implies is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f)}
\item \texttt{hom-normed-vector-space-subset-hom-bounded-linear} (proven): \texttt{hom-normed-vector-space(a, b) subset hom-bounded-linear(a, b)}
\item \texttt{hom-uniformly-continuous-subset-hom-continuous} (proven): \texttt{hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b) subset hom-continuous(a, b)}
\item \texttt{lipschitz-arrow-is-uniformly-continuous-arrow} (proven): \texttt{is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f) implies is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f)}
\item \texttt{uniformly-continuous-arrow-is-continuous-arrow} (proven): \texttt{is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) implies is-continuous-arrow(a, b, f)}
\end{itemize}
